steps.en: Officer confirms applying the bulk decision to the selected notices
steps.id: Officer mengonfirmasi penerapan bulk decision ke notice yang dipilih
steps.why_en: The portal has no bulk confirm step for court notices.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya langkah konfirmasi bulk untuk court notice.

steps.en: OCMS applies the decision to all selected court notices in bulk
steps.id: OCMS menerapkan keputusan ke semua court notice terpilih secara bulk
steps.why_en: Bulk apply exists but is triggered by external systems, not by the officer.
steps.why_id: Bulk apply ada, tetapi dipicu sistem eksternal, bukan oleh officer.

steps.en: Decision values are saved on the notices so the portal respects them
steps.id: Nilai keputusan tersimpan di notice sehingga portal mengikutinya
steps.why_en: Only some values are saved, and the cutoff job skips the data the portal reads.
steps.why_id: Hanya sebagian nilai yang disimpan, dan cutoff tidak mengubah data yang dibaca portal.

steps.en: Officer sees a success prompt after the bulk decision is applied
steps.id: Officer melihat prompt sukses setelah bulk decision diterapkan
steps.why_en: The portal shows no success prompt for a bulk decision.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak menampilkan prompt sukses untuk bulk decision.
